description: This header file provides high-level utility functions for creating and manipulating AST nodes and hierarchies in the ANGLE shader compiler, including functions for creating nodes, declaring variables, referencing built-in variables, and ensuring block structures.

methods.name: CreateInternalFunctionPrototypeNode
methods.description: Creates a function prototype node from a given function object.

methods.name: CreateInternalFunctionDefinitionNode
methods.description: Creates a function definition node with a specified function object and body.

methods.name: CreateZeroNode
methods.description: Creates a node representing zero of a given type.

methods.name: CreateFloatNode
methods.description: Creates a constant node with a float value.

methods.name: CreateIndexNode
methods.description: Creates a constant node with an index value.

methods.name: CreateTempVariable
methods.description: Creates a temporary variable of a specified type and optional qualifier.

methods.name: CreateTempSymbolNode
methods.description: Creates a symbol node for a temporary variable.

methods.name: CreateTempDeclarationNode
methods.description: Creates a declaration node for a temporary variable.

methods.name: CreateTempInitDeclarationNode
methods.description: Creates a declaration node with an initializer for a temporary variable.

methods.name: CreateTempAssignmentNode
methods.description: Creates an assignment node for a temporary variable.

methods.name: DeclareTempVariable
methods.description: Declares a temporary variable with specified type, qualifier, and optional initializer.

methods.name: DeclareInterfaceBlock
methods.description: Declares an interface block with specified parameters.

methods.name: EnsureBlock
methods.description: Ensures the given node is a block node, wrapping it if necessary.

methods.name: ReferenceGlobalVariable
methods.description: References a global variable by name from the symbol table.

methods.name: ReferenceBuiltInVariable
methods.description: References a built-in variable by name and shader version.

methods.name: CreateBuiltInFunctionCallNode
methods.description: Creates a node representing a call to a built-in function with arguments.

methods.name: GetSwizzleIndex
methods.description: Populates a vector with swizzle indices.

methods.name: CreateSwizzle
methods.description: Creates a swizzle node from a reference and indices.
